name: Holds Service Control Policy
description: An AWS Organizations organization holds a customer-managed service control policy (organization -> SCP), as organizations:ListPolicies(Filter=SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY) lists it. Containment, emitted for customer-managed policies only: an AWS-managed policy such as FullAWSAccess has one ARN in every organization, so no one organization contains it. A completed listing that no longer names a customer-managed SCP makes it a retirement candidate for DescribePolicy to judge.
